title: Missing TAS annotation in QuickGO

author: ValWood
source_title: part_of relation missing from GO basic

author: pgaudet
body:
I confirmed that the annotation is missing from P2GO and QuickGO, I cannot find it in the [syntax checks](https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/contrib/goa/reports/), but it’s in the upstream  (https://www.pombase.org/data/annotations/Gene_ontology/gene_association.pombase.gz)

> PomBase	SPBC31E1.04	pep12	enables	GO:0005484	PMID:14575697	TAS		F	endosomal membrane t-SNARE Pep12		protein	taxon:4896	20031027	PomBase


It's not in the GORULES reports either: 
https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/contrib/goa/goex/current/qc_reports/PomBase_SPOM_gorule_report.html
